planning_discipline.evidence: 11/18 sessions (61%) invoked /planner. Feature work consistently planned. Operational work (teardown, GPU upgrade, model swap) routinely skipped planning despite 30+ files touched.

contract_negotiation.evidence: 6 formal negotiations. 3 had meaningful REVISE with blockers. Average rounds: 1.5. But only 33% of non-trivial tasks had contracts. Benchmarks, reports, and infra work all skipped.

evaluator_adversarial_quality.evidence: 12 formal evals. All used shell commands + code inspection. 2 FAIL→fix→PASS cycles (v5-autonomous, harness-rewrite). Report-audit found 3 blocking issues. w3 negotiation caught concurrency bug pre-implementation.

session_hygiene.evidence: Handoffs in 8/18 sessions. 4 sessions exceeded 4h (one ran 10h with 46/61 auto-messages). CONTEXT HEALTH hook triggered correctly but was advisory-only. Session boundaries not enforced.

user_prompt_quality.evidence: Bilingual (PT/EN). Consistently specific with explicit goals. User demonstrated exceptional critical thinking — challenged assumptions, cited external research, self-enforced harness discipline. Occasional terse prompts ('Go', 'Sim') in later session turns.
notable_user_behaviors: Self-enforced harness discipline when system didn't
Full delegation with explicit scope constraints

skill_utilization.evidence: 14 skills configured, effectively 0 invoked. experiment-workflow relevant to 5 sessions, iac-templates to 3, data-science-analysis to 4, code-review to 14+ commits, tech-writing to 3. Root cause: agent never self-triggers skills.

progress_tracking.evidence: 180 breadcrumbs across 18 sessions (10 avg/session). TodoWrite used in most multi-step sessions. 23 malformed commit breadcrumbs. Some sessions batched breadcrumbs at end rather than per-step. Session f8b10f4c had best tracking (12 breadcrumbs).

H1_planning_skipped.detail: 3/18 sessions skipped planning on truly non-trivial work (6h mega-session, major restructure, 5h calibration)

H2_little_debate.detail: When negotiation happens it's substantive (2 blockers found in w3). But 67% of non-trivial tasks had no contract at all.

H3_missing_analysis_skill.detail: experiment-workflow skill existed but was never invoked. Reports had arithmetic errors, missing methodology, inconsistent formatting.

H4_missing_presentation_skill.detail: All benchmark results as raw markdown. Report-audit found presentation issues: inconsistent rounding, missing annotations, misleading headers.

key_findings: HARNESS GATE hook was the only effective enforcement mechanism — it forced evaluator 3x in session f8b10f4c, which had the best adversarial quality
Skill auto-activation is completely broken: 14 skills × 0 invocations = entire skills library is dead weight
Contract gate is too narrow: only triggers on feat-* tasks, missing benchmarks/reports/infra
Session circuit breaker is advisory-only and consistently ignored after 90 min
Evaluator quality is the harness's strength — finds real bugs when engaged

comparison_to_reference.context: Gap explained by time pressure (5-day event deadline) vs ongoing infrastructure project. Not a harness failure — a compliance enforcement gap.
